# Luckwell CO., LTD

> Taiwan-based exporter of used motorcycles (KYMCO, Yamaha, SYM, AEON, PGO) and used cars (Hyundai, Nissan, Suzuki, Toyota). Export only, wholesale, container-load orders, based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

## Official websites
- [Company website](https://www.luckwell.com/): Luckwell CO., LTD main company site.
- [Used motorcycle catalog](https://catalog.luckwell.com/): full used motorcycle and car export catalog with inquiry cart (this site).
- [Used vehicle catalog 2](https://car.luckwell.com/): used cars and motorcycles catalog.

## Key facts
- MOQ motorcycles: 50 units per 20FT, 125 units per 40HQ container.
- MOQ cars: 5 units per 40HQ container.
- Indicative FOB Kaohsiung price: motorcycles US$185-900 per unit, cars US$1,880-4,680 per unit, depending on model, year and condition grade. Final quotation is sent with the current stock list.
- Markets: Ghana, Madagascar, Ivory Coast, Iraq, Pakistan, Yemen, Oman, Nigeria.
- Contact: via WhatsApp inquiry button on the catalog site.

## How to order (motorcycles)
- Send quantities per model (plus any used engines or tires) and packing method; pay a 50% deposit; goods are collected in 4-6 weeks; photos and videos are sent for confirmation; shipment is booked after your confirmation; balance and shipping fee are paid when the loading date is notified; loading photos/videos, BL and packing list are provided.
- Full steps: https://catalog.luckwell.com/catalog.html#how-to-order

## French
- [Catalogue en français (French version of the catalog)](https://catalog.luckwell.com/fr/catalog.html): catalogue de motos et voitures d'occasion à l'export, MOQ, étapes de commande.
